question:
Select the option that is related to the fifth letter-cluster in the same way as the second letter-cluster is related to the first letter-cluster and the fourth letter-cluster is related to the third letter-cluster.

BET : UXM :: SYP : LRI :: HOX : ?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d7fd46426f00ba56b91d423458faa673503496b14e50413ec14eae6a6e84c211.png] 

The logic followed here is :-

 
• BET : UXM

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f17586dc7bc649a93348dfbfbdde730e7db556f29ecc70defd21c4f59ca36a95.png] 

and

 
• SYP : LRI

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/413ee30a59717135c3df9ca60551920b90064288070beb895f2a119edf07fab9.png] 

Similarly,

 
• HOX : ?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/50f01bd8ca6629805adc722a236942db710bc6c353a00bc2349818cc0d7bb5d1.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"AHQ".**
